purpose: Make the import-aware module graph part of the parsed Program snapshot so semantic and interface consumers can receive graph state without depending on FrontendSession filesystem loading.
question: Where should the explicit import graph live when the frontend hands a parsed snapshot to TypeChecker and later module-interface consumers?
decision: Program carries an optional value snapshot of ModuleGraph. FrontendSession populates it only for successful import-aware file assembly, and the value matches the graph exposed by FrontendSession::moduleGraph() at that boundary. Stdin and ordered direct multi-file combined-entry programs leave the optional graph empty.

representation.types_header: include/ModuleGraph.hpp owns ModuleGraph, ModuleGraphNode, ModuleGraphEdge, and ModuleGraphEdgeKind independently of FrontendSession.
representation.program_field: Program::moduleGraph is std::optional<ModuleGraph> and is copied as part of the Program snapshot.
representation.import_aware: assembleProgram attaches the graph after all import-aware units and edges have loaded successfully.
representation.direct_modes: loadStdin and the no-import direct multi-file fast path retain an empty optional graph.
representation.lifetime: The graph value is independent of later FrontendSession reset or reload operations.

compatibility_boundary.semantic_consumers: TypeChecker, DeclarationIndex, IR, bytecode, module-interface text, and the Rust VM do not consume the graph in this slice.
compatibility_boundary.loader_accessor: FrontendSession::moduleGraph remains available during migration for loader clients and focused tests.
compatibility_boundary.behavior: No source visibility, diagnostic, IR, bytecode, artifact, or runtime behavior changes.

migration: Move graph types to a standalone header, attach a value copy to import-aware Program assembly, and assert equality between the session graph and program snapshot. Later M3A slices migrate one semantic/interface consumer at a time; M3B owns dependency-body removal and incremental compilation.
quantitative_gate: The frontend_session and ir_source_location CTest cases prove import-aware graph handoff plus empty stdin/direct-entry compatibility paths. The m0d-2026-07-22-r1 inventory validates 1,745 cases, and the canonical verification and legacy parity commands report zero unexplained differences.
old_path_deletion_condition: Delete no production path in this slice. Retire the session-only accessor only after all graph consumers read Program::moduleGraph and no consumer depends on filesystem-loader state; direct-entry compatibility paths remain documented.
affected_consumers: future TypeChecker and module-interface graph consumers
source metadata and module identity tests
out_of_scope: graph serialization, cache keys, and per-module artifacts
changes to direct multi-file, stdin, diagnostics, IR, bytecode, or Rust VM behavior
